claim: `PresheafOfModulesOfCommRing.map` (and likewise `PresheafOfModulesOfCommRing.obj`) shadows the structure projection under dot notation: for `M : PresheafOfModulesOfCommRing R`, `M.map f` now elaborates to the new constant `PresheafOfModulesOfCommRing.map`, and `rw` with the existing API about `PresheafOfModules.map` (`PresheafOfModules.map_id`, `PresheafOfModules.map_comp`, ...) no longer finds its pattern. The abbrev therefore makes the new spelling worse to work with than the one it replaces.
requested_change: Delete the `obj` and `map` abbrevs (lines 50-57), so that `M.obj X` and `M.map f` resolve to `PresheafOfModules.obj`/`PresheafOfModules.map` and every existing lemma about them applies; the `Module (R.obj X) (M.obj X)` instance already provided in `Mathlib/Algebra/Category/ModuleCat/Presheaf.lean` covers the scalar action. (If the specialised types are really wanted, restate `map_id` and `map_comp` for the new `map`, with `@[simp]`/`@[reassoc]` to match the originals.)

claim: `PresheafOfModulesOfCommRing.pushforward₀` duplicates the existing `PresheafOfModules.pushforward₀OfCommRingCat` (Mathlib/Algebra/Category/ModuleCat/Presheaf/Pushforward.lean:71), which the PR description itself names as the motivating example. After this PR the library has two names for the same functor, and the `Monoidal` instance in PushforwardZeroMonoidal.lean is stated only on the old one.
requested_change: Make `PresheafOfModulesOfCommRing.pushforward₀` the single name: remove `PresheafOfModules.pushforward₀OfCommRingCat` from Pushforward.lean, replace it with `@[deprecated (since := "2026-09-29")] alias PresheafOfModules.pushforward₀OfCommRingCat := PresheafOfModulesOfCommRing.pushforward₀` (this needs the new abbrev to live no lower than Pushforward.lean, see the file-level finding), and state the `Monoidal` instance in PushforwardZeroMonoidal.lean as `(PresheafOfModulesOfCommRing.pushforward₀ F R).Monoidal`.

claim: The new file imports `Mathlib.Algebra.Category.ModuleCat.Presheaf.Pullback` for all its content. The core abbrev `PresheafOfModulesOfCommRing` and the whole `Basic` section need only `Presheaf.ChangeOfRings`, and the pushforward abbrevs need only `Presheaf.Pushforward`. The files that already work over `PresheafOfModules (R ⋙ forget₂ _ _)` (Presheaf/Monoidal.lean, Presheaf/PushforwardZeroMonoidal.lean, Differentials/Presheaf.lean, Stalk.lean, and `pushforward₀OfCommRingCat` in Pushforward.lean) import only `Presheaf` or `Pushforward`. None of them can adopt the new namespace without pulling in Pullback, and with it Generator, Abelian, Free, ShortComplex.Exact and the partial-adjoint machinery. That defeats the stated goal of a namespace in which to put all of these.
requested_change: Split the file by import level. Define `PresheafOfModulesOfCommRing` and the `Basic` section (`mk`, `mkHom`, `isoMk`, `unit`, `restrictScalars`) in a file importing only `Mathlib.Algebra.Category.ModuleCat.Presheaf.ChangeOfRings`. Put `pushforward₀` and `pushforward` in or next to `Presheaf/Pushforward.lean`, and `pullback` and `pullbackPushforwardAdjunction` in or next to `Presheaf/Pullback.lean`.

claim: `mkHom` departs from the library's naming convention for morphism constructors, which is `homMk` (paired with `isoMk`: `Over.homMk`/`Over.isoMk`, `Arrow.homMk`/`Arrow.isoMk`, `PresheafOfModules.homMk`/`PresheafOfModules.isoMk`). It also sits next to `isoMk` in this same file, so the two sibling constructors are named inconsistently.

The `naturality` argument of `mkHom` has no default proof. In `PresheafOfModules.Hom.naturality`, and in the sibling `isoMk` in this file, it is an auto-param `:= by cat_disch`. The wrapper is therefore strictly less convenient than the structure it wraps.
requested_change: Give `naturality` the default `:= by cat_disch` in `mkHom`, as `isoMk` and `PresheafOfModules.Hom` do.

claim: `mk` makes `map_id` and `map_comp` mandatory explicit arguments. In the `PresheafOfModules` structure it wraps, both fields default to `by cat_disch`. So `PresheafOfModulesOfCommRing.mk obj map` cannot be written even where the anonymous constructor would discharge the obligations automatically.
requested_change: Add the defaults `:= by cat_disch` to the `map_id` and `map_comp` binders of `mk`, matching the fields of `PresheafOfModules`.

requested_change: Change line 11 to `# Modules over presheaves of commutative rings`.
